description: passes EG's answer to one of Scala's filing questions to Scala: files the inbox scan in the named folder and remembers it
notes: Drives adws/adw_interface_scala_answer.py. Normally bypassed: Toyota reaches the same ADW through ScalaAnswerRunner, with no model in the path, and ScalaAnswerRoute forces the route for any message naming Scala or a bills_511/ or documents_511/ folder. Questions, lessons and the ledger are in ~/scala/ (SCALA_HOME overrides). No Write/Edit: the ADW is the only writer.
